app.name: Halo CE Wii
app.long_description:
Unofficial Homebrew Channel stub for a future Halo: Combat Evolved engine port.
This build looks for *.map in sd:/apps/halo-ce/maps (loose files first; game.iso only if none were identified, and not past 2 GiB). It lists those cache files, draws the first structure BSP with a lightmap or bitmap from that cache on GX, and runs OpenCE game_tick. Without a map the screen says the retail file is missing. With one, it says the map was found. That is not a finished campaign. Script special forms execute. Opening a map allocates a 23 MiB tag arena and fills the rest of it with a pixel slab. Fifteen portals join sixteen clusters, and a point outside a portal quad is rejected. Four wheels settle on the floor over many ticks while tire slip friction drives the jeep, holds it on line, and builds a ground contact point. Entering a vehicle starts the seat-enter animation. The Xbox cache address is not mapped. No game data is included.
Not affiliated with Microsoft, Xbox Game Studios, Halo Studios, Activision, or Bungie. JojoXDK's private Wii work in progress is a different project and is not included here.
